function.arguments: {"observation": "`customer_age` contains 108 values of exactly -1, which the documentation says means 'the customer did not supply an age'. This is not a real age.", "implication": "These -1 values must be excluded from the mean age calculation, because they are not measurements of age — they are missing data sentinels. Including them would bias the mean downward (since -1 < 0), and treating them as real ages would be invalid. The mean should be computed only on valid ages (i.e. age >= 0)."}
function.name: note_finding
